title: Connector link frame envelope
description: The fields every frame on wss://<hub>/connector carries (C-05.10, C-05.11). Each frame also validates against its own kind's schema in the other 05 files; this envelope is open (additionalProperties true) because it is the common base those close. Protocol 1 sends text frames of one JSON object each.

ch.description: The channel. `blobs` is reserved for a later protocol and refused in protocol 1.

kind.description: The frame kind, dotted, unique within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction, from 1 (C-05.11).

re.description: The id of the frame this one answers, when it answers one.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative only.
